english.notes: No minimum published on ucla.edu (re-read 2026-10-20). https://admission.ucla.edu/apply/international-applicants: 'We look for competitive English proficiency scores, including a TOEFL iBT score of 5 or higher (with sub-scores of 5 or higher) on the revised scale (effective January 21, 2026), or above 100 (with sub-scores above 24) on the previous 120-point scale, as well as 7.5 or above on the IELTS or 135 or higher on the Duolingo English Test (DET).' Competitive levels, not minimums. A UC-system-wide minimum, if any, sits on universityofcalifornia.edu, which is not a ucla.edu official domain, and was not read.
